description:
This project renovated MiaCucina's showroom on Miracle Mile in Coral Gables, where the brand displays bespoke Italian kitchens, custom closets, spa-inspired bathrooms, architectural interior and exterior doors, wall paneling, and living space furnishings.

The space showcases Italian craftsmanship and precision engineering through warm woodwork, natural stone, and integrated modern lighting.
